data.label: Photosystem II
data.description: Water-plastoquinone photo-oxidoreductase. Splits water at the Mn4CaO5 cluster and reduces plastoquinone through the QA/QB sites.

data.label: Plastoquinone pool (PQ / PQH2)
data.description: Mobile two-electron carrier between PSII and cytochrome b6f. Its redox poise is the plastid's central regulatory signal.

data.label: Plastosemiquinone (PQ·−)
data.description: One-electron-reduced plastoquinone at the QA/QB and Qo sites.

data.label: Cytochrome b6f Rieske [2Fe-2S] (PETC)
data.description: His/Cys-ligated [2Fe-2S] centre of the cytochrome b6f complex, driving the plastid Q cycle and contributing to the proton motive force.

data.label: Cytochrome b6 / f hemes (PETA, PETB)
data.description: The b- and f-type hemes of the b6f complex, including the unusual covalently bound heme ci.

data.label: Plastocyanin (PETE1/2)
data.description: Mobile type-I copper carrier from cytochrome b6f to photosystem I.

data.label: Photosystem I Fe/S centres (FX, FA, FB)
data.description: Three [4Fe-4S] clusters carrying electrons from the P700 primary acceptors to ferredoxin. FX sits on the PsaA/PsaB heterodimer; FA and FB on PsaC.

data.label: Ferredoxin (FD1, FD2)
data.description: Soluble [2Fe-2S] one-electron carrier distributing electrons from PSI to FNR, nitrite reductase, sulfite reductase, glutamate synthase and the thioredoxin system.

data.label: Ferredoxin-NADP+ reductase (FNR1, FNR2)
data.description: FAD enzyme converting two one-electron transfers from ferredoxin into the two-electron reduction of NADP+.

data.label: Cyclic electron flow (PGR5 / PGRL1)
data.description: Antimycin-sensitive cyclic route returning electrons from ferredoxin to the plastoquinone pool, raising ATP yield relative to NADPH.

data.label: Plastid superoxide / H2O2
data.description: ROS from the PSI acceptor side (Mehler reaction) and PSII, dismutated by stromal FeSOD and CuZnSOD.

data.label: Thylakoid ATP synthase
data.description: Uses the thylakoid proton motive force to phosphorylate ADP.

data.label: Cryptochrome 1 (CRY1)
data.description: Blue-light photoreceptor with a non-covalently bound FAD. Photoreduction proceeds through a conserved tryptophan triad, generating a FAD·−/Trp·+ radical pair.

data.label: Cryptochrome 2 (CRY2)
data.description: Blue-light receptor governing photoperiodic flowering through CO and FT. Light-labile, unlike CRY1.

data.label: Cryptochrome FAD cofactor
data.description: The flavin adenine dinucleotide whose redox state (FADox / FAD·− / FADH·) carries the photoreceptor's signalling state.

data.label: Tryptophan triad (Trp·+)
data.description: Three conserved tryptophans conducting an electron from the protein surface to the flavin, leaving a tryptophanyl radical as the pair's second member.

data.label: Singlet ⇄ triplet interconversion
data.description: Coherent mixing of the radical pair's spin states, at a rate set by hyperfine couplings and modulated by an external field. The step at which a weak field can change a chemical yield without changing any activation energy.

data.label: Phytochrome B
data.description: Red/far-red photoreceptor with a bilin chromophore, acting with cryptochrome on flowering and hypocotyl growth.

data.label: COP1 / SPA complex
data.description: E3 ubiquitin ligase complex inhibited by photoactivated cryptochrome; degrades HY5 and CO in darkness.

data.label: Flowering time (CO → FT)
data.description: Photoperiodic flowering output. The most reproducible near-null-field phenotype in the Arabidopsis literature.

data.label: Cysteine desulfurase NFS1 (ISC)
data.description: PLP-dependent cysteine desulfurase supplying persulfide sulfur for mitochondrial cluster assembly. The sulfur entry point of the ISC pathway.

data.label: Scaffold ISU1 (ISC)
data.description: The scaffold on which a nascent [2Fe-2S] cluster is built before transfer to a recipient apoprotein.

data.label: Frataxin (FH)
data.description: Iron chaperone/regulator of ISC assembly, dual-targeted to mitochondria and chloroplasts in Arabidopsis and required for chloroplast Fe-S protein function.

data.label: Transfer machinery (HSCB, GRXS15)
data.description: Co-chaperone and monothiol glutaredoxin handling cluster release from the scaffold and delivery to recipients.

data.label: NFU carriers (NFU4, NFU5)
data.description: Late-acting carrier proteins delivering clusters to specific apoproteins.

data.label: SUF system (plastid assembly)
data.description: The plastid's sulfur-mobilisation machinery: the SUFB-C-D scaffold complex with the SUFE-activated cysteine desulfurase CpNifS.

data.label: Plastid cluster carriers (CnfU, HCF101)
data.description: NifU-like scaffold and the [4Fe-4S] carrier required for photosystem I assembly.

data.label: CIA system (cytosolic assembly)
data.description: Cytosolic iron-sulfur assembly machinery maturing cytosolic and nuclear Fe/S proteins, including DNA polymerases, primase, helicases and ribonucleotide reductase.

data.label: ATM3 / ABCB25 sulfur export
data.description: Inner-membrane ABC transporter exporting a sulfur-containing intermediate from the mitochondrion to the cytosol.

data.label: Cellular Fe / S supply
data.description: The iron and sulfur pools every assembly system draws on. Where the review's actual near-null-field evidence sits.

data.label: Fe/S client proteins
data.description: Everything downstream: aconitase, succinate dehydrogenase, the Rieske centres, PSI, ferredoxin, lipoyl synthase, ribonucleotide reductase, nitrite and sulfite reductases, glutamate synthase, and the DNA replication and repair enzymes.

data.label: Near-null magnetic field (< 1 uT)
data.description: The experimental condition: the local geomagnetic field actively compensated or shielded to nanotesla-to-low-microtesla values.

data.label: Geomagnetic field (25-65 uT)
data.description: The ambient terrestrial field — the reference condition, not a treatment.

data.label: Root iron uptake (FRO2, IRT1, FIT)
data.description: Strategy I iron acquisition: ferric chelate reductase FRO2 reduces Fe(III) at the root surface, IRT1 transports Fe(II), and the bHLH transcription factor FIT coordinates both.

data.label: Iron storage and distribution (FER1/4, NAS4, NRAMP3/4)
data.description: Ferritin storage, nicotianamine-mediated distribution and vacuolar remobilisation — the buffering between uptake and the assembly systems on QBM-04.

data.label: Sulfate assimilation (SULTR, APS1, APR, SIR)
data.description: Sulfate uptake and reduction to sulfide: transporters, ATP sulfurylase, APS reductase and the Fe/S-containing sulfite reductase.

data.label: Cysteine synthesis (SAT1, OASA1)
data.description: Serine acetyltransferase and O-acetylserine(thiol)lyase, producing the cysteine that is the sulfur donor for Fe/S assembly.

data.label: Gibberellin signalling (GA3OX1, GA20OX1, RGA, GAI, RGL2)
data.description: GA biosynthesis and the DELLA repressors it degrades. Controls germination potential and flowering time.

data.label: Auxin transport and signalling (PIN1/2/3, AUX1, TIR1, ARF7)
data.description: Polar auxin efflux carriers, influx carrier, receptor and response factor — the machinery that sets root and shoot architecture.

data.label: Circadian clock (CCA1, LHY, TOC1, PRR5/7/9, GI, ELF4)
data.description: The transcriptional-translational oscillator gating light input and photoperiodic flowering.

data.label: Flowering regulators (CO, FT, FLC, SOC1)
data.description: The photoperiod and vernalisation integrators through which the clock and cryptochrome set flowering time.

data.label: Reproductive output (siliques, seed yield)
data.description: Silique number, fruit growth and seed yield — the agronomic endpoint, and the reason the review argues the question matters for crop support.

data.label: Primary metabolism
data.description: ATP supply, NAD(P)H balance, carbon skeleton flux — the layer the review argues has been overlooked in favour of photoreceptor signalling.

data.label: Brassica crop translation
data.description: Seed vigour, oil mobilisation, chloroplast establishment and yield in B. napus and B. oleracea.

data.label: Complex I (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase)
data.description: Entry point for matrix NADH. Carries one FMN and a chain of Fe/S clusters that conduct electrons roughly 90 Å to the quinone site, pumping protons.

data.label: Complex I FMN site
data.description: The flavin mononucleotide that accepts a hydride from NADH and passes electrons on singly, transiting a semiquinone radical state.

data.label: Complex II (succinate dehydrogenase)
data.description: Shared node of the TCA cycle and the respiratory chain. A covalent FAD on SDH1 oxidises succinate; [2Fe-2S], [4Fe-4S] and [3Fe-4S] clusters on SDH2 carry the electrons to ubiquinone.

data.label: Rieske [2Fe-2S] centre (complex III)
data.description: His/Cys-ligated [2Fe-2S] centre whose large domain movement drives the bifurcated Q cycle.

data.label: Ubisemiquinone (UQ·−)
data.description: One-electron-reduced ubiquinone, the radical intermediate of the Q cycle.

data.label: Complex IV (cytochrome c oxidase)
data.description: Terminal oxidase. Electrons enter at the binuclear CuA site, pass through heme a to the heme a3/CuB binuclear centre where O2 is reduced to water through paramagnetic intermediates.

data.label: Cytochrome c
data.description: Mobile c-type heme carrier between complex III and complex IV; also links mitochondrial state to ABA-dependent germination control.

data.label: Alternative oxidase (AOX)
data.description: Di-iron quinol oxidase that bypasses complexes III and IV, reducing O2 without pumping protons. Uncouples electron flux from ATP yield.

data.label: Alternative NAD(P)H dehydrogenases (NDA/NDB)
data.description: Rotenone-insensitive type II NAD(P)H dehydrogenases on both faces of the inner membrane. They oxidise NAD(P)H without proton pumping, bypassing complex I.

data.label: Aconitase (ACO1/2/3)
data.description: Citrate-isocitrate isomerase carrying a solvent-exposed [4Fe-4S] cluster with one non-cysteinyl-ligated iron used for substrate binding.

data.label: Lipoyl synthase (LIP1)
data.description: Radical-SAM enzyme that inserts sulfur into the lipoyl cofactor, consuming one of its own [4Fe-4S] clusters as the sulfur donor.

data.label: Mitochondrial superoxide / H2O2
data.description: ROS produced at complex I's flavin and complex III's Qo site, dismutated by matrix MnSOD. The signalling amplifier between a small change in electron branching and a transcriptional response.

data.label: ATP synthase (complex V)
data.description: Uses the proton motive force to phosphorylate ADP.

data.label: NADH / NAD+
data.description: Matrix redox couple; substrate for complex I.

data.label: Ubiquinone pool (UQ / UQH2)
data.description: Two-electron carrier whose one-electron intermediate is the semiquinone.

data.label: Superoxide dismutases (CSD1/2, MSD1, FSD1)
data.description: Cu/Zn, Mn and Fe superoxide dismutases converting superoxide to hydrogen peroxide in the cytosol, chloroplast and mitochondrial matrix respectively.

data.label: Ascorbate peroxidase (APX1, APX2)
data.description: Heme peroxidases reducing H2O2 at the expense of ascorbate; the first step of the ascorbate-glutathione cycle.

data.label: Catalase (CAT1, CAT2, CAT3)
data.description: Heme enzymes dismutating H2O2 to water and oxygen, dominant in the peroxisome where beta-oxidation generates peroxide by design.

data.label: Ascorbate-glutathione cycle (GR1, DHAR1, MDAR1)
data.description: Glutathione reductase, dehydroascorbate reductase and monodehydroascorbate reductase, regenerating ascorbate and glutathione at the cost of NAD(P)H.

data.label: Peroxiredoxin / thioredoxin system (PRXIIF)
data.description: Thiol-based peroxide reduction, regenerated by thioredoxin. The mitochondrial matrix's main peroxide sink.

data.label: Ascorbate / glutathione / NAD(P)H pools
data.description: The cell's redox buffers. Their ratios, not their totals, are what a near-null-field metabolomics experiment should report.

data.label: ROS-responsive transcriptional programme
data.description: The downstream gene-expression response to a shift in redox poise — the layer at which the most substantial near-null-field dataset was actually measured.

data.label: Citrate synthase (CSY4)
data.description: Condenses acetyl-CoA with oxaloacetate to close the cycle. The step that makes the TCA cycle a cycle.

data.label: Isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH1, IDH2)
data.description: Oxidative decarboxylation of isocitrate to 2-oxoglutarate, generating NADH.

data.label: TAG lipase (SDP1)
data.description: Initiates triacylglycerol breakdown in the oil body, releasing fatty acids for beta-oxidation. The first committed step of oilseed reserve mobilisation.

data.label: Peroxisomal beta-oxidation
data.description: Converts stored fatty acids to acetyl-CoA, feeding the glyoxylate cycle during heterotrophic establishment.

data.label: Glyoxylate cycle (ICL, MLS)
data.description: Isocitrate lyase and malate synthase bypass the two decarboxylating steps of the TCA cycle, letting a seedling make sugars from stored lipid.

data.label: ATP / ADP ratio (pre-photosynthetic)
data.description: Adenylate energy charge during imbibition and radicle emergence, supplied almost entirely by mitochondrial respiration.

data.label: Radicle emergence
data.description: The completion of germination, and the earliest visible endpoint at which a pre-photosynthetic metabolic lesion could be detected.
